description: ACCDB AutoNumber table An (ID COUNTER PK, K LONG unique, S TEXT(50), D DOUBLE) with counter at 10 and ID 10 deleted (existing row ID 1 K 1, so data page has room and counter is 10). Src has explicit IDs equal to the counter: row 1 (ID 10, K 10) accepted, row 2 (ID 10, K 20) refused 3022 by PK. INSERT INTO An (ID, K, S) SELECT ID, K, S FROM Src ORDER BY N with dbFailOnError. Keeps pages 0-1 and 42+ after setup, after statement (1500 ms pause), and after follow-up auto INSERT; reads TableDef.RecordCount and rows.
